props.name: columns
props.description: Columns in display order. Defaults to every key seen, in first-seen order.

props.name: maxCategories
props.description: Strings with at most this many distinct values are treated as categories.

props.name: bins
props.description: Histogram bins for numbers and dates.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for each column's name, so the cards sit under the page's outline.
